articles.summary: Parties agree in principle to pursue acquisition of 100% of Tranglo, subject to definitive documentation and agreement with Ripple Markets APAC SINGAPORE, Oct. 30, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Currenc Group Inc. (Nasdaq: CURR) (“Currenc” or the “Company”), a provider of artificial intelligence (AI) solutions to financial institutions, today announced that its wholly owned subsidiary, Seamless Group Inc. (“Seamless”), and New Margin Holding Limited (“New Margin”) have signed a reinstatement and amendment letter dated October 29, 2026 (the “Reinstatement Letter”) in relation to the share purchase agreement dated January 1, 2026 (the “SPA”) concerning Tranglo Sdn. Bhd. (“Tranglo”). The Reinstatement Letter reinstates the SPA effective from New Margin’s countersignature on October 29, 2026 and extends the longstop date to March 31, 2027. articles.title: Currenc Group Announces Signed Reinstatement of Tranglo SPA and Agreement in Principle for Proposed 100% Acquisition at US$666.7 Million and Extension of Longstop Date to March 31, 2027
